consequence.statement: DestinationRules for the same host whose exportTo attributes are totally different are no longer merged, so the configuration that takes effect for that host may change.
consequence.remediation: Check DestinationRules that share a host but have different exportTo values. To keep the old merging behavior, set ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE=false in the pilot deployment.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24.0 stops merging DestinationRules for the same host when their exportTo attributes are totally different; setting the ENABLE_ENHANCED_DESTINATIONRULE_MERGE environment variable to false in the pilot deployment turns this new behavior off.
